book-001.synopsis: When a family holiday drive ends in a sudden, devastating collision involving their autonomous vehicle, the Cassidy-Shaw household is thrust into a high-stakes investigation where human choices and algorithmic decisions blur. Retreating to a quiet rental along the Chesapeake Bay while authorities reconstruct the crash, husband and wife confront fractures in their marriage, protective instincts toward their children, and the uncomfortable question of who truly bears blame when technology and private secrets collide.

sources.label: Open Library Search — Culpability (Bruce Holsinger)

book-002.synopsis: In Macon, Georgia, Georgia Bureau of Investigation agent Will Trent takes on a perilous undercover assignment inside a violent local criminal network. The operation becomes deeply personal when Will discovers that Detective Lena Adams—whose history with the people closest to Will is already fraught with grief and distrust—is entangled near the heart of the case, forcing Will and medical examiner Sara Linton into a tense race for the truth.

sources.label: Open Library — Unseen by Karin Slaughter

book-003.synopsis: Abby and Sam seem to have everything: a loving marriage, successful careers, and a beautiful home—everything except the child they desperately want. When Abby meets Monica, an eager and seemingly warm young woman who offers to be their surrogate, it feels like a miracle. But as Monica moves into their guest room, small unsettling discoveries accumulate, and Abby begins to realize that Monica's past harbors chilling secrets that threaten everything Abby cherishes.

sources.label: Open Library — The Surrogate Mother by Freida McFadden

sources.label: Open Library — That's Not My Name by Megan Lally

Examining how relentless involuntary thought binds the human spirit, Atmamun presents a direct, uncompromising inquiry into discovering authentic peace and living beyond the anxieties of the manufactured self.

sources.label: Open Library — Atmamun by Kapil Gupta

sources.label: Open Library — The Poet Empress by Shen Tao

sources.label: Open Library — My Life with the Walter Boys by Ali Novak

book-076.synopsis: Locked in solitary confinement for 264 days because her skin is lethal to anyone who touches her, seventeen-year-old Juliette Ferrars is viewed by the totalitarian Reestablishment as either a monster or a weapon. When she is given a cellmate who remembers her from childhood and brought before the ruthless young commander Warner, Juliette discovers the strength to fight back.

sources.label: Open Library — Shatter Me by Tahereh Mafi

book-077.synopsis: Reclusive Hollywood icon Evelyn Hugo chooses unknown magazine reporter Monique Grant to write her no-holds-barred biography—and no one is more puzzled by the choice than Monique herself. Summoned to Evelyn's Upper East Side apartment, Monique listens as the legendary actress recounts her rise from 1950s Los Angeles, the seven marriages that made headlines, and the true love she spent her life protecting.

sources.label: Open Library — The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo by Taylor Jenkins Reid

book-078.synopsis: High school student Avery Grambs is scraping by until eccentric billionaire Tobias Hawthorne dies and leaves almost his entire fortune to her—a stranger he never met. To claim the inheritance, Avery must move into sprawling, secret-passage-filled Hawthorne House alongside the billionaire's disinherited family and his four brilliant, puzzle-obsessed grandsons.

sources.label: Open Library — The Inheritance Games by Jennifer Lynn Barnes

book-079.synopsis: After their rival publishing houses merge, vibrant Lucy Hutton and buttoned-up Joshua Templeman sit across from each other every day as executive assistants to the co-CEOs, trading daily mind games from the Staring Game to the Mirror Game. When a single managing director promotion opens up, their rivalry escalates—Right until an elevator ride changes the rules.

sources.label: Open Library — The Hating Game by Sally Thorne

book-080.synopsis: Neuroscientist Bee Königswasser lands her dream opportunity leading a neuroengineering helmet project at NASA alongside the NIH—only to discover her co-lead is Levi Ward, her tall, brooding grad-school nemesis. When her lab equipment goes missing and she vents to her anonymous online friend @Shmac, Bee begins to see a very different side of Levi.

sources.label: Open Library — Love on the Brain by Ali Hazelwood

book-081.synopsis: After quiet classmate Archer Morales dies following a school dance, seventeen-year-old Hadley Jamison is approached at his funeral by Death himself with an unprecedented offer: travel back twenty-seven days in time to stop Archer from ending his life. As Hadley gets to know the boy behind the quiet reputation, she realizes how much she never noticed.

sources.label: Open Library — In 27 Days by Alison Gervais

book-082.synopsis: Struggling New York writer Lowen Ashleigh accepts the career-saving offer of a lifetime: finish the remaining novels in a hit series for bestselling thriller author Verity Crawford, who was severely injured in a car crash. Moving into the Crawford home to sort through Verity's office notes, Lowen uncovers an unfinished manuscript filled with chilling confessions about the family's past.

sources.label: Open Library — Verity by Colleen Hoover

book-083.synopsis: Picking up after It Ends with Us, floral shop owner Lily Bloom navigates life as a single mother in Boston while co-parenting her baby daughter with her ex-husband Ryle. When she unexpectedly crosses paths on a busy street with Atlas Corrigan—the boy who sheltered her in their youth and now runs two thriving restaurants—the two cautiously explore whether their timing has finally arrived.

sources.label: Open Library — It Starts with Us by Colleen Hoover

book-084.synopsis: Moving into her brother's San Francisco apartment while finishing her nursing degree, Tate Collins meets airline pilot Miles Archer. Miles makes no secret that he wants neither love nor a future—only an arrangement with two rules: never ask about the past and never expect a tomorrow. Alternating between the present and Miles's history six years earlier, their bond tests every wall he built.

sources.label: Open Library — Ugly Love by Colleen Hoover

book-085.synopsis: After serving five years in prison for a tragic mistake, Kenna Rowan returns to the town where everything went wrong, hoping for a chance to meet her four-year-old daughter. Shut out by everyone in her late boyfriend's circle except Ledger Ward—a local bar owner who has helped raise her child—Kenna and Ledger risk the trust of their entire community as they grow closer. book-086.synopsis: Fresh out of college, Lily Bloom moves to Boston to open her own unconventionally styled flower shop and meets charismatic neurosurgeon Ryle Kincaid. As their relationship deepens and old journals bring back memories of her first love, Atlas Corrigan, Lily is forced to confront painful truths about her childhood home and summon the courage to break a generational cycle.
